invariants.rationale: prefHeight is assigned using Math.max with non-negative values (font heights, background dimensions), thus it is non-negative.
prefWidth is always set to 0 or greater, and only increased or set to Math.max of non-negative values.
If selectedPrefWidth is true, prefWidth is at minimum the sum of bg's left and right widths (if bg not null), otherwise 0.
If scrollPane is null or not disableY, prefWidth is set as Math.max(prefWidth, scrollWidth); so prefWidth is at least scrollWidth in these cases.
